_comment: dontaskagain-mcp: the exact version. npm_published true: the wizard runs npx -y <npx_package> from npm; the wizard's path/URL field overrides it (npx -y -p <path|url> dontaskagain-mcp). npx_url is the same version on the site, a fallback for machines without npm registry access (npm_published false switches the default back to it).
